content:
[Intro]
[D]

[Verse 1]
[D]In the dark, we are without her
empress light
In the dark, we are without a
light
Half a sleep, we calmly waiting
through her night
Half a sleep, we wait 'til she
arrives

[Bridge]
[D]

[Verse 2]
[D]Clouds of birds are covering the
dark blue sky
Clouds of birds are covering the
sky
A rush of wind is gently playing
with their wings
And yellow stars are standing all
arise

[Bridge]
[D]

[Verse 3]
[D]All rejoices, all we are
in her hands
All rejoice, we are in her
hands
Our lives of sun are rising
like the land
All rejoice, we are in her
hands

[Outro]
[D]
title: Rejoicing In The Hands
tuning: E A D G B E
